items.title: My Little Pony's New Post-Friendship Is Magic Era Is Officially A Major Hit
items.summary: A new era of My Little Pony officially begins with massive success. While its first three generations were charming childhood staples, My Little Pony launched a new era in 2010 when Lauren Faust revitalized the property with My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic . The fourth generation unexpectedly captivated older teens and adults alongside kids, and gave rise to a passionate worldwide fandom, with fan conventions, viral music scenes, and complex comic book lore. Across nine acclaimed seasons, My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic transcended its toy-commercial roots to become a genuine pop-culture juggernaut.

The 2014 novel, which blends sci-fi with the dystopian YA tone that dominated the first half of the 2010s, became a bestseller and spawned two sequels, creating one of the new millennium's best and most celebrated trilogies. items.title: ‘Jay and Silent Bob’ Officially Return With a Major New Movie Update [Exclusive]
items.summary: 25 years have passed since the iconic duo of Jay and Silent Bob got their first solo film, Jay and Silent Bob Strike Back , yet the two are still going on new adventures. Since then, they've broken containment to appear directly or spiritually in places far beyond the View Askewniverse, most recently in the acclaimed 2025 comedy Napa Boys and the official Archie crossover comic . Earlier this year, Jason Mewes also took a trip back to turn-of-the-century Toronto for a special guest appearance on the long-running Murdoch Mysteries , where he performed a much cleaner, but still hilarious spoof of Jay's profane rap outside the Quick Stop . More excitingly, though, Kevin Smith has another feature on the way with the two inseparable platonic partners in life.
